items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dick – the guy who lived there. He played piano himself.

ctx.x: It felt great, yeah. That was a hell of a performance space. Dick – the guy who lived there. He played piano himself.
Dick Whittington. That was just – to have a place like that in your house to play in, wow. It looked like a cathedral, with real high ceilings. It was incredible.
